description: Manages core system administration tasks, including database migrations and other backend maintenance operations.

endpoints.name: RunMigrations
endpoints.description: Initiates and runs pending database migrations to update the system's database schema. This operation is typically performed during system deployment or upgrades to ensure the database structure is up-to-date with the application's requirements.
example_uses: Run the latest database migrations for the system.
Execute all pending system database updates.
Update the application's database schema to the newest version.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the system's database schema needs to be updated to match the current application version, typically after a new deployment or an application upgrade. This ensures data consistency and compatibility.
